test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 22% above its cost price and offers a 15% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of Rs. 111, then what is the list price (in Rs.) of the fan?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of the fan = Rs. x

List price (LP) = CP + 22% of CP = 1.22 × CP

Discount offered = 15% of LP

Profit earned = Rs. 111

**Formula Used:**

Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

Discount = 15% of LP = 0.15 × LP

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be Rs. x.

List price (LP) = 1.22 × x

Discount = 0.15 × 1.22 × x

Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

SP = 1.22 × x - 0.15 × 1.22 × x

SP = 1.22 × x (1 - 0.15)

SP = 1.22 × x × 0.85

SP = 1.037 × x

Given profit = Rs. 111

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ 111 = 1.037 × x - x

⇒ 111 = 0.037 × x

⇒ x = 111 / 0.037

⇒ x ≈ 3000

List Price (LP) = 1.22 × x

LP = 1.22 × 3000

LP = 3660

**The list price of the fan is Rs. 3660.**
